thread.title: Apple Hits $1 Trillion Market Cap

author: Tom Lydon
title: Apple Hits $1 Trillion Market Cap
text:
Shutterstock photo Apple ( AAPL ) hit a $1 trillion market cap on Thursday, becoming the first publicly traded U.S. company to break the record valuation. Although Apple's third-quarter is often viewed as the company's most "boring" season, the tech giant beat earnings estimates on Wednesday and saw its shares jump nearly 3 percent, reaching a session high of $207.05 [...] Read more on ETFtrends.com.
